title: Tuna Tostada
description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring seared tuna, served on a crispy corn tortilla with a side of earthy, dense salsa.

ingredients.name: Corn Tortillas
ingredients.notes: Look for corn tortillas that are free from additives

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Season the tuna steaks with salt and pepper.
3. Grill the tuna steaks for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
4. Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
5. Toast the tortillas on the grill or in a dry skillet for 1-2 minutes per side.
6. Assemble the tostadas by spreading a layer of earthy, dense salsa on each tortilla.
7. Top the salsa with a piece of grilled tuna, some crumbled Venezuelan chorizo, and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
8. Serve immediately with a lime wedge on the side.
